clusters.title: Black Friday deals for liquid Brazilian butt lifts criticised over safety fears
clusters.neutral_headline: Black Friday deals for liquid Brazilian butt lifts criticised over safety fears

items.title: Black Friday deals for liquid Brazilian butt lifts criticised over safety fears
items.standfirst: Experts say BBLs and other cosmetic procedures can be risky and seasonal offers at clinics in England could make people rush decisionsClinics in England are promoting seasonal deals – including for Black Friday – on liquid Brazilian butt lifts (BBLs), despite concerns about the risks of the procedure.The government is consulting on limiting liquid BBLs, vampire facials and deep chemical peels in England to qualified healthcare professionals. The proposals follow the death of Alice Webb, a 33-year-old mother of five, after a botched liquid BBL in a Gloucester salon in 2024. Her family have called for laws against “cosmetic cowboys” to be introduced before more people die. Continue reading...
